officials.name: Adam Schlick

officials.bio: Adam Schlick (District 2) is a Lake County Board Member with a current term from 2024-2028. Board Member Schlick represents District 2, which includes Wauconda and portions of Hawthorn Woods, Mundelein, Round Lake, and Round Lake Park.

officials.name: Ann Maine
officials.address: 18 N County Street, 10th Floor, Waukegan, IL 60085
officials.bio: Ann Maine has served on the Lake County Board since 2002, representing District 3. Her priorities include fiscal responsibility, sustainability, and protecting natural resources. She holds a B.A., M.S., and Ph.D. in Biochemistry and is an Assistant Professor of Biology at Lake Forest College.

officials.name: Brandon X. Ewing
officials.address: 18 N County Street, 10th Floor, Waukegan, IL 60085
officials.bio: Lake County Board Member. Current Term: August-December 2026. Board Member Ewing represents portions of Waukegan and North Chicago.

officials.name: Carissa Casbon
officials.address: 18 N County Street, 10th Floor, Waukegan, IL 60085
officials.bio: Board member Casbon represents the District 7, which includes portions of Gurnee and Waukegan. She has been on the board since 2020.

officials.name: Diane Hewitt
officials.address: 18 N County Street, 10th Floor, Waukegan, IL 60085
officials.bio: Board member Hewitt represents District 8, which includes portions of Beach Park and Waukegan. She has been on the board since 2008. Her main priorities are ﬁscal responsibility, transportation, and economic growth.

officials.name: Gina Roberts
officials.address: 18 N County Street, 10th Floor, Waukegan, IL 60085
officials.bio: Board member Roberts represents District 4, which includes Winthrop Harbor, Zion and portions of Beach Park. She has been on the board since 2020.

officials.name: J. Kevin Hunter
officials.address: 18 N County Street, 10th Floor, Waukegan, IL 60085
officials.bio: J. Kevin Hunter represents District 5, which includes the Villages of Fox Lake and Lake Villa, and portions of Antioch, Grant, and Lake Villa Townships. He has been involved in the community through various elected, appointed, and volunteer activities, including serving as a village trustee, high school board member, and a retired Firefighter/EMT. He is committed to serving the community he has resided in for 31 years with passion and integrity.

officials.name: Jessica Vealitzek
officials.address: 18 N County Street, 10th Floor, Waukegan, IL 60085
officials.bio: Board member Vealitzek represents District 10, which includes Indian Creek and portions of Hawthorn Woods, Lake Zurich, Long Grove, Mundelein, and Vernon Hills. She has been on the board since 2018, with priorities including environmental stewardship, infrastructure investment, and responsible government. She holds a B.A. from Lake Forest College, an M.F.A. from Roosevelt University, and a certification in Secondary English Education.

officials.name: John Wasik
officials.address: 18 N County Street, 10th Floor, Waukegan, IL 60085
officials.bio: Board member Wasik represents District 6, which includes Grayslake, Hainesville, Round Lake, Highland Lake and Third Lake, and portions of Fremont and Lake Villa Townships (West Miltmore and Venetian Village). He resides in Grayslake with his wife and two daughters, owns a small business called JK Enterprises and is a professional speaker and journalist who has authored 19 books. He is also an environmental steward, musician and avid hiker and cyclist. He has a B.A. and M.A. from the University of Illinois, Chicago.

officials.name: Linda Pedersen
officials.address: 18 N County Street, 10th Floor, Waukegan, IL 60085
officials.bio: Board member Pedersen represents District 1, which includes Antioch, Lindenhurst, Old Mill Creek and Wadsworth. She has been on the board since 2008. Her main priorities are fiscal responsibility, economic growth and business expansion, and smart growth and development.

officials.name: Kinnis Williams Sr
officials.bio: Kinnis Williams was sworn in as Circuit Clerk in December 2022. As a statutory Judicial Administrator, the Circuit Clerk is responsible for maintaining official court records for all civil and criminal cases, interacting with judges, lawyers, and the public to perform duties such as filing cases and collecting/disbursing fines and fees.

officials.name: Jennifer Gomric-Minton
officials.bio: Jennifer Gomric Minton is the St. Clair County Assessor, elected in November 2010. She holds Certified Illinois Assessor Officer and CIAO-Intermediate designations and has served on the Executive Board of the Chief Assessment Official Association, currently as President. As Assessor, she oversees the daily operations of the office, ensuring fair and equitable property assessments in St. Clair County.

officials.name: Patty Sprague
officials.bio: Patty A. Sprague has been the Auditor of St. Clair County since October, 2003, having previously served on the St. Clair County Board of Review. The Auditor is considered the “Watch Dog” of St. Clair County, with state laws requiring at least 20 hours of continuing professional education annually for the auditor.

officials.name: Mark Kern
officials.bio: Mark Kern was elected as St. Clair County Board Chairman in 2004. Prior to that, he was the Mayor of Belleville.

officials.name: Thomas Holbrook
officials.bio: Thomas Holbrook was appointed to the office of County Clerk on July 1, 2013, elected to this office in 2014, and re-elected in 2018. Tom graduated from SIUE in 1971 with a BA in Social Science. Tom was elected to the position of St. Clair County Board Member, District 10, from 1981 to 1994, and elected Illinois State Representative, District 113, from 1995-2011. Tom was appointed to Chairman of the Illinois Pollution Control Board from 2011-2013.

officials.name: Michael Crockett
officials.office: St. Clair County Recorder of Deeds

officials.name: Richard "Rick" Watson
officials.bio: Sheriff Richard "Rick" Watson began his law enforcement career in 1978, retiring as Chief of Police in Cahokia in 2011. He is a graduate of Eastern Illinois University, Lindenwood University, and the FBI Academy in Quantico, VA.

officials.name: Andrew Lopinot
officials.bio: Andrew Lopinot has been the St. Clair County Treasurer since 2018. He is passionate about public service and helping his community. Prior to being elected as the St. Clair County Treasurer in 2018, Andrew served as the Chief Deputy Treasurer in the office. He also previously represented his neighbors and community as an Alderman for the City of O'Fallon.

officials.name: James Gomric
officials.bio: Jim Gomric was born and raised in Belleville, Illinois, graduating Magna Cum Laude from Saint Louis University in 1992 and Saint Louis University School of Law in 1995. He began his legal career as an assistant state's attorney for St. Clair County in 1995, later transitioning to the Public Defender's Office and private practice before becoming State's Attorney.
